svg.text: 100-bay heavy vehicle park with driver amenities
Great North Road (T2), Mkushi, Central Province
1. Do not scale. Use figured dimensions only.
2. Site plan dims in metres; building dims in mm.
3. Levels in metres, relative to site datum
4. Boundary and road reserve assumed from
aerial imagery. Confirm by cadastral survey
5. Land south of original 1.0 ha plot (0.80 ha)
to be secured before any further design.
6. Read with structural, civil, M&E and
Local site grid, setting-out points & key dimensions
Re-planned: 101 bays on 1.80 ha; full set
Row A rear kerb, north end
Row A rear kerb, south end
Row B bay front, north end
Row C bay front, north end
Row D rear kerb, west end
Row D rear kerb, east end

1. Site grid: origin at beacon B4 (SW corner), E positive east, N positive north, aligned to the T2 frontage. Site grid assumed parallel to UTM grid; grid convergence at 29.39°E ≈ 0.56° — surveyor to establish rotation.

2. UTM 35S (WGS84) values are derived from the client coordinate −13.644732°, 29.394103° taken as the centre of the original 1.0 ha plot. Accuracy ±10 m: NOT for setting out. A registered land surveyor shall tie the site grid to the national control network (Arc 1950 / UTM 35S) and re-issue this schedule.
3. Beacons B3, B4 are proposed and depend on securing the additional 0.80 ha. B5/B6 mark the original plot.
4. Bay setting-out: all bays 4.000 m wide from the north end of each row (rows A: N146.000, B/C: N138.000), measured along the bay-front line; row D from S17 westward.
5. Building setting-out from grid 1/A (S6) and 11/C (S7); grid spacing 3 600 mm (A-200).
6. Tolerances: kerbs ±10 mm line, ±5 mm level; bay lines ±20 mm; building grids ±5 mm.
